sources.citation: Hooley, B. A. & K. A. McElhanon. 1970. Languages of the Morobe District, New Guinea. In S. A. Wurm & D. C. Laycock (eds.), Pacific linguistic studies in honour of Arthur Capell, 1065-1094. Pacific Linguistics C-13.

sources.note: Barim-102 named as a Siassi Family member on Umboi; classification only, nothing on stress.
Alt. name Barim; villages near Wasu, on Umboi, and near Saidor; ~915 speakers (2000); notes Karnai materials in Arthur Capell's Paradisec collections AC1 and AC2. No phonology.

sources.note: The only descriptive source for Karnai (Glottolog's sole grammar sketch; Grambank coded the whole language from it). Its author wrote the Arop-Lokep stress paper (Raymond 2006), so a comparative sketch by her almost certainly has a phonology section with a stress statement for Karnai.
